ModelValidatorExternal.release_notes:
### Regulatory Check

- **New: Regulatory Check.** Tools > Regulatory Check (also from a suite's Config Health report) checks the project's configuration against its regulatory body's official guideline: every test the guideline lists, the values each row must have (power levels, SCR and X/R, fault type, impedance and duration, events), the cases a test must cover, and optional tests. Each finding names the guideline table and clause, and fixes such as a wrong value or a missing case can be applied one at a time to the project's own copy of the configuration.
- **Requirements Drafted from the Official Guideline.** The AI reads the body's current guideline (downloading it, or from a link or file you give it), maps every test onto the project's suites, and saves a draft of what the guideline asks. You review the draft and accept it; until then the check marks it as a draft. Requirements are kept on this computer and the check warns when they haven't been reviewed for a year, so a new guideline edition isn't missed.
- **Changed: Config Health Keeps Its Built-In Checks Only.** The per-suite AI Full Check is replaced by the Regulatory Check, which covers the whole body.

### Reports

- **New: Deliverables Window.** Clicking the Report stage of a suite shows everything it produces for a submission in the current mode: a results report per report sheet, the Validation Report, each Annex Report sheet with the suites and tests it picks, and the Compliance Computer's export. Each shows its latest file and whether it is up to date, older than the results or validation it shows, or not generated yet, with Generate and Open buttons.
- **New: Pick the Annex Report's Tests.** The Annex Report has a Tests tab listing every suite of the project with its tests, to tick the ones each annex sheet reports on; it shows which simulators have results for each test in the current mode.
- **New: Ask AI in the Report Setup.** Ask AI opens the AI Assistant on the sheet you are editing (results report or Annex Report) to build or change its plots, pages, metrics or, for an annex sheet, its tests. It replaces the separate AI Report Author window.
- **Changed: Clearer Report Names.** Results report rows name the report sheet they come from.

### Channel Mapping and Validation

- **Changed: One Mapping Window.** The mapping dialog fills its own table with Auto-map — every channel type and connection the suite's validations need, for each simulator with results, linked into benchmark groups — and says what it couldn't map. Ask AI hands the mapping to the AI Assistant. The separate AI Mapper window is gone.
- **Changed: One Unit per Quantity.** Validations now run on one unit per quantity — active power in MW, reactive power in MVAR, voltage in pu, reactive current in pu — so the mapping no longer asks for the same quantity in a second unit.
- **Fixed: Scaling Expressions Referring to a CurveId.** A scaling expression can refer to another curve as `<CurveId>` or `<channel name>`; compliance validation now resolves CurveIds as benchmarking and plots do.
- **Fixed: Channel Mapping Per Suite.** The channel mapping is stored per test suite instead of being shared by every suite of a mode; existing projects keep their mapping.
- **New: Out-of-Date Validation Shown.** A test whose results changed after it was validated shows a yellow validation button, and the AI reports it as stale.

### Suite Readiness and Project Creation

- **New: Readiness Bar.** Each suite tab shows where it stands — Setup › Run › Validation mapping › Validation › Report — each with a status, a summary and a click that takes the next step.
- **New: Plant Parameters at Project Creation.** The Project Manager's Create page asks for the plant's capacity and POC voltage, presets the grid frequency from the regulatory body, and sets SCR and X/R at the POC. A folder being registered or imported keeps its own settings.
- **Fixed: New Projects Use the Region's Grid Frequency.** New projects start at the regulatory body's grid frequency (e.g. 60 Hz) instead of always 50 Hz.
- **Changed: Busy Check and Clearing.** Switching projects waits for any running suite, report or pipeline, and "Clear last selection" asks before closing suites that are running.

### AI Assistant

- **New: Plots in the Assistant.** The Assistant can plot channels from any simulator and test — or the iterations of a tuning session — in the chat, and sees the plot itself.
- **Changed: Clearer Chat.** Messages show formatted text and tables, grouped tool steps, approval and error boxes and a working indicator.
- **More of the App Under AI Control.** The Assistant can tick tests, read and edit a suite's table, set or replace a case, set report metrics, read and change version and column settings, and check where a suite stands; it is refused while the matching editor has unsaved changes.
- **Fixed: AI Configuration Changes Lost on Close.** Closing AI Configuration with unsaved changes now asks whether to save them instead of discarding them, and a failed save is reported.

### Other Fixes

- **Fixed: Saving Left a Background Thread Behind.** Every save of a suite's configuration left a thread running until the app closed.
- **Fixed: Benchmark Plots.** The Result Viewer and the Validation Report draw one plot per channel type with every simulator against the reference.
- **Fixed: Editable Column Names.** Names such as `e'enable` were cut to `nable`.
